newsitem.title: USA: Nashua, N.H. said best place in U.S. to live.
newsitem.headline: Nashua, N.H. said best place in U.S. to live.

text.p: Money magazine named Nashua, New Hampshire, as the best place to live in the United States on Wednesday and government officials held a news conference to boast about the distinction.
"Money magazine has confirmed what we already knew: that New Hampshire is a great place to live and work," New Hampshire Gov. Jeanne Shaheen told reporters in front of the town's city hall.

It is the second time the city, the state's second largest that has become home to 20 percent of the New England's biggest manufacturing employers, has been named number one by the magazine. The first time was in 1987.
